addOns.name: Usage-based credits: production deploys 15 credits ($0.10 each), bandwidth 20 credits/GB ($0.13/GB), compute 10 credits/GB-hour ($0.07/GB-hour), web requests 2 credits/10k ($0.01/10k), variable AI inference cost

cautions.en: Netlify's model shifted to a credit-based system: monthly plan fees include a credit allowance, and usage beyond it (deploys, bandwidth, compute, requests) is billed per-credit, so effective monthly cost can exceed the headline plan price for high-traffic sites.

capabilities.en: JAMstack/modern web hosting with Git-based, AI-assisted, or API-driven deploys and unlimited deploy previews.
Serverless functions, AI model access, database storage, and blob storage available from the free tier.
Global CDN, custom domains with automatic SSL, and basic firewall/rate limiting included even on the free plan.

limitations.en: Usage-based credit billing means production deploys, bandwidth, and compute all consume credits, making costs less predictable than a flat monthly fee for high-traffic projects.
Advanced security/observability features (extended observability window, SSO/SCIM, log drains) are reserved for paid Personal/Pro tiers or Enterprise.

reason.en: Direct competitor for JAMstack/frontend hosting and Git-based deploys.
Competing deployment platform for web apps, often compared for pricing and performance.
Alternative hosting/deployment platform used for similar web app hosting needs, though with a broader infrastructure scope.

unknowns: Exact credit-to-dollar conversion nuances for AI inference usage were only partially detailed ("variable by model") on the pricing page.
